chapter_seo_title: Da Gui Yi Xian Ch 422 – “The Godmother” — Bai Lingmiao Buys a Future
chapter_meta_description: An injured Lü Xiucai begs Bai Lingmiao for mercy. She buys a dozen starved children from a slave trader—and dispatches an assassin to the empty street.
og_description: Bai Lingmiao purchases orphans, signs their deeds as a “godmother,” and sends the Second Spirit into the street. A slaver is about to have a very bad day.
twitter_description: Starved kids, a trafficker, and a drumbeat. Bai Lingmiao is building her power base, one “adopted child” at a time.

lore_anchors.definition: A ritual drum-chant from northeastern Chinese Chuma medium tradition; its urgent, rhythmic beat compels spirits into action or presence.
A dealer in human beings, often buying the desperate poor and selling them as laborers or servants; legal fictions like “adopted children” were used to circumvent anti-slavery laws.
A fictive kinship term used to create a legal relationship that mimics family without blood ties; historically used to disguise de facto ownership of laborers.
